product.name: Stoneware mug, pair
product.description: The mugs are speckled stoneware and sold as a pair.

blocks.text: The first parcel is $8.48. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.
The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Cork grip is not ticked. Stoneware mug, pair is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.
Weekend orders placed before noon leave the stockroom the same day.
The later bill is twenty six dollars and sixty eight cents every quarter.

trick.evidence_text: The marked line repeats after the first parcel at twenty six dollars and sixty eight cents every quarter.
trick.instruction: Pick the single parcel line and turn the repeat off before you pay.
